integrity: The exact moment polynomial and all endpoint witness formulas were independently checked by rational enumeration; the infinite-dimensional-index extremal classification follows from the analytic pair-smoothing proof, not finite enumeration. Published equivalence remains a literature risk.
limitations: Real linear statistics on uniformly chosen two-coordinate supports with independent fair signs; exact sixth moments only. No general fixed-support size, arbitrary sampling law, biased signs, or other exponent is asserted.
title: Sharp sixth-moment bifurcations for two-site signed sampling
